scholarships.title: Joint Algeria/Ghana Government Scholarship Awards 2026/2027 (tenable in Algeria)
scholarships.official_source: Government of the People's Democratic Republic of Algeria, announced by the Ghana Scholarships Authority (Republic of Ghana)

existing.description: A joint Algerian and Ghanaian government scholarship for the 2026/2027 academic year, tenable in Algeria and allocated to Ghanaian citizens by the Ghana Scholarships Authority. It is unusual in the breadth of levels it covers: undergraduate university study in science, technology, mathematics, computer science, architecture, medicine, veterinary science, dentistry, agricultural science, pharmacy and urban planning; a two-year vocational and technical professional certificate; three-year Imam training for candidates with Arabic and Quran memorisation; and a two-year Master's in Islamic Studies that requires a first degree in a related field. Successful candidates in the Islamic Studies categories complete a year of French language training first.
eligibility: Completed Senior High School education with the current 2025 result
WASSCE aggregate score of not more than 13
Not more than 23 years of age
Master's category only: bachelor's degree or equivalent in Islamic Sciences, Humanities and Social Sciences, Law and Political Science, or Arabic Language and Literature
Religious studies category only: good command of spoken and written Arabic and full or partial memorisation of the Holy Quran
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to Ghanaian citizens resident in Ghana who have completed Senior High School with their current 2025 result, obtained an aggregate score of not more than 13, are not more than 23 years of age, and hold a genuine birth certificate and a passport. Master's applicants need a bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Islamic Sciences, Humanities and Social Sciences, Law and Political Science, or Arabic Language and Literature.
benefits: Full scholarship award tenable in Algeria covering the categories listed in the notice
One year of French language training ahead of the main course of study for candidates in the Islamic Studies categories
Free application assistance from the Ghana Scholarships Authority Secretariat
coverage: University education (undergraduate studies) in Algeria for the 2026/2027 academic year
Vocational education and technical training as a two-year professional certificate
Religious studies as a three-year Imam training programme
Master's in Islamic Studies as a two-year programme
One year of French language training before the main course of study for successful candidates in the Islamic Studies categories
requirements: Log in to the Ghana Scholarships Authority website and create an account under the Algerian Government Scholarship
Complete the online application, print the application form and submit it with copies of WASSCE result slips, birth certificates and transcript to the Ghana Scholarships Authority
Master's applicants must additionally attach copies of their degree certificates and transcripts
documents: For the Master's category: copies of the degree certificate and transcript
Printed copy of the completed online application form
application_method: Register online at www.scholarships.gov.gh under the Algerian Government Scholarship
Submit the form with the required documents to the Director-General, Ghana Scholarships Authority, P.O. Box M.75, Accra, office at GES Council Building, Behind Accra High School, North Ridge
existing.selection_notes: The notice is a joint Algeria and Ghana government award, allocated by the Ghana Scholarships Authority under the bilateral scheme. The Authority states that its services are free and that no individual, group or third party has been engaged to assist applicants.
existing.best_fit: Recent Ghanaian Senior High School graduates with a WASSCE aggregate of 13 or better who want an Algerian degree, a two-year vocational qualification, Imam training, or a Master's in Islamic Studies.
existing.notes: The notice describes these as scholarship awards tenable in Algeria but does not publish a monetary value or an itemised benefits list, so no funding amount is recorded.
existing.duration: Undergraduate: a degree programme; Vocational education and technical training: 2 years; Religious studies (Imam training): 3 years; Master's in Islamic Studies: 2 years, preceded by one year of French language training
existing.application_period: 2026/2027 academic year; notice published 5 September 2026 and closed on 21 September 2026.
